Passively increases Blade Barrage impact and explosive damage by 25%.

For each 5 <solar/>Blade Barrage knives you land, a <solar/>Solar Detonation is triggered after ~2 seconds. A maximum of 2 Solar Detonations can trigger per cast.

Each <solar/>Solar Detonation deals significant damage over a 10 meter radius with no falloff and releases 4 <solar/>Scorching Shrapnel, which each apply <solar/>20 Scorch (unaffected by <solar/>Ember of Ashes?). Detonation and shrapnel deal ~35% reduced damage to Boss-Tier combatants and are unaffected by the Super Stat.

Overall boosts Blade Barrage damage against Boss Combatants by roughly ~140%.
